insurer_name: The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.
residency_requirement: Indian resident; product targeted at younger insured (Yuva = youth)
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Plan-tiered: Base (3.1-3.16), Gold (Critical Care, Personal Accident, Air Ambulance, Auto Top-Up), Platinum (Maternity, Infertility, Well Baby, Birth Right Benefit)

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Indemnity to full Sum Insured; reinstatement of SI in Base plan; auto top-up in Gold/Platinum

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All listed day care procedures plus 12 Modern Treatments

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Up to 100% of Sum Insured for Ayurveda / Yoga / Naturopathy / Homeopathy / Siddha / Unani

ambulance_cover.notes: Road ambulance in Base; Air ambulance in Gold/Platinum

maternity_coverage.notes: Platinum plan only; enhanced maternity limit at additional premium; includes well baby cover and birth right benefit

newborn_coverage.notes: Covered in Base; Well Baby cover under Platinum

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Gold/Platinum only — 15 critical illnesses (cancer, MI, CABG, valve surgery, coma, kidney failure, stroke, organ transplant, paralysis, MND, MS, third-degree burns, major head trauma, end-stage lung failure, end-stage liver failure)

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Reinstatement of Sum Insured included in Base plan

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Health check-up cost included in Base plan

room_rent_capping: No room rent capping (premium youth product)
notable_exclusions_summary: Plan-tiered product (Base / Gold / Platinum). Maternity and infertility only on Platinum. Critical illness only on Gold/Platinum. Hazardous sports covered (Base+). Includes medical second opinion and health check-up.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA at network hospital. Pre-auth within 1 hour, final discharge within 3 hours. Reimbursement document submission post-discharge.
